method: Frozen PowerShell launcher sampled host CPU three times at two-second intervals, queried NVIDIA-SMI and Windows free memory, and rejected before task/model artifact verification.
rejection_reasons: Host CPU mean and maximum exceeded the frozen limits
GPU utilization exceeded the frozen limit
Free system memory was below the frozen minimum
interpretation: Host-state observation only. No task, model, or protocol result was collected. Do not retry until host CPU/GPU load and free RAM materially change.
